sloka: स बली बलवत् क्रोधात् गृहीत्वा पुरुष ऋषभः ।कैकेयीम् अभिनिर्भर्त्स्य बभाषे परुषम् वचः ॥२-७८-१९॥
transliteration: sa balī balavat krodhāt gṛhītvā puruṣa ṛṣabhaḥ ।kaikeyīm abhinirbhartsya babhāṣe paruṣam vacaḥ ॥2-78-19॥

translations.english: The mighty and the best of men Satrughna seized with fury, forcibly caught hold of that hunchback and censured Kaikeyi with harsh words.
